versions.changelog: Library-wide disclaimer: guidance, not professional advice
Description tail link + agents machine-readable metadata line (deciqai.com/s/us-business-registry-open-data.json)
Footer now uses /c/<slug> short link (fixes UTM truncation when SKILL.md is read in a terminal)

- Initial release of US Business Registry Open Data skill.
- Enables access to complete business registry datasets for NY, CO, PA, OR, and CT (~12.4M entities) with commercial use rights.
- Details APIs, rate limits, required entity deduplication logic, normalization schema, and licensing/legal caveats.
- Includes a Python 3-based fetcher with no dependencies and full configuration for dataset mapping.
- Outlines strict activation criteria: only for US company registration data in supported states; excludes license data and states with no free API.
- Provides a verified dataset registry, usage process, rate-limit findings, common data pitfalls, and clear guidance on what is/not available by state.
